brief.working_title: Samsung and Google’s AI Glasses: What Founders Can Build Now
brief.subject: November12 Samsung intelligent eyewear and feasible Android XR/Meta founder development
brief.origin: Primary-source launch/API verification plus original tested mock capture/approval starter
brief.thesis: Own accepted work and its evidence; ship a phone-first workflow while proving each device adapter and distribution permission.
brief.reader: AI founders and experienced application engineers
brief.reader_baseline: Already understands APIs, cloud inference, SaaS and agent runtimes
brief.reader_delta: Can choose a supported surface, run a bounded local workflow and test willingness to pay without unsupported device claims
brief.stakes: Avoid building around unavailable sensors, blocked publishing and uneconomic continuous capture
brief.strongest_objection: Built-in Gemini/Meta AI can absorb generic assistants; integrations and accepted records must earn retention
brief.commercial_relationship: Owned free educational kit and proposed paid developer product; no vendor affiliate claim
